## Why visit

An essential companion to the Philharmonic, with lavish carved wood, copper, elaborate plasterwork and formidable fireplaces. Give particular attention to the smoke room and ask whether the former billiard room, now a function space, can be seen. The restoration and return of cask make old descriptions dismissing it as a no-real-ale venue misleading for this trip. Its location near the station makes it easy to include, but the rooms deserve a proper visit rather than a hurried look while waiting for a train.

## Beer

CAMRA documents cask reintroduction after the 2023 refurbishment and lists bitters, pale ales and porter alongside changing guests. CAMRA lists Ossett Silver King, Titanic Plum Porter, Timothy Taylor Landlord and Theakston Best Bitter as regular cask leads; Beartown and Neptune appear among changing suppliers.

## Plan the visit

Grade II* listed; CAMRA three-star interior. The rear Heritage Suite is not always open. Sports screens may affect the mood.

**Getting there:** Lime Street near the station; combine with Crown Hotel and Liverpool Brewing Company Tap.

Check [November transport issues](../logistics.md) for date-specific disruption.
